newsitem.title: WESTERN SAMOA: RUGBY UNION-TUIGAMALA SPEARHEADS SAMOA TO TITLE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TUIGAMALA SPEARHEADS SAMOA TO TITLE.

text.p: Samoan centre Vaaiga Tuigamala played a storming game as Samoa beat a determined Fiji 26-17 to snatch the Pacific Tri-series championship.
Tuigamala broke through from a set piece to pound through the Fijian defence line for a try between the posts in the first minute of the match and kept up the pressure throughout.
He led the home side's attack with barging runs, forcing the Fijian defence to keep their game tight. Ferocious tackling from both sides meant the game was littered with injury breaks.
Fiji stuck to their guns and made sure there was no walkover, with fly half Nickie Little keeping the ball in front of his forwards and eventually scoring a try after an overlap.
But another Samoan try, wide out by hooker Tala Leasamaivo, made the score 17-7 at half time and a cluster of three second half penalties by fly half Earl Va'a kept the threat from Fiji at bay.
Fijian scrum half Mosese Rauluni scored a consolation try in the dying seconds.

Samoa: Silao Leaega, Afato So'oalo, Vaaiga Tuigamala, George Leaupepe, Brian Lima, Earl Va'a, Joe Filemu; Pat Lam (capt), Junior Paramore, Sam Kaleta, Sene Taala, Potu Leavasa, Robbie Ale, Tala Leasamaivao, Mike Mika.

Fiji: Jonetani Waqa, Fero Lasagavibau, Aisea Tuilevu, Alfred Uluinayau, Nickie Little, Mosese Rauluni; Alivereti Mocelutu, Aminasi Naituyaga, Simon Raiwalui, Emori Katalau, Sale Sorovaki, Daniel Rouse, Epeli Naituivau, Mosese Taga, Greg Smith (capt).
